narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a relatable family scenario (a son challenging his mother to a shopping spree) to transition into a warning about online shopping scams. It then promotes Chunghwa Telecom's 'Anti-hacking Gatekeeper' service as a solution to prevent fraud and protect personal data, ending with a call to action regarding an iPhone giveaway.
